about: Laqabs and titles the «بمَ لُقّب؟» quiz and the «الألقاب» card leave out, keyed by the fact's id (unit#assertion), each with its source. They stay on the person's page.

skip.siyar-v4-41-muadh-ibn-amr#a_ma_killer: Not one man's: in al-Bukhari (3141) and Muslim (1752) the Prophet ﷺ tells Mu'adh ibn 'Amr ibn al-Jamuh and Mu'adh ibn 'Afra' «كلاكما قتله».
skip.siyar-v4-55-saad-ibn-ubadah#a_su_kamil: Not one man's: Ibn Sa'd (al-Tabaqat) gives «الكامل», the jahili name for one who wrote, swam and shot well, to several of the Ansar, Usayd ibn Hudayr and Rafi' ibn Malik among them.
skip.siyar-v5-19-aisha#a_a_humayra: Ibn al-Qayyim, al-Manar al-Munif: every hadith that calls her «الحميراء» is invented, but for a few; not taught as settled.
